body:
- ogw_smoothing_scale_fraction: 0.15 -> 1.0 (smoothing scale near the grid scale), the value used in the ClimaCoupler AMIP and weather configurations.
- precipitation_evaporation_coefficient: 0.0 -> 1.36e-4 s^-1, tuned for coupled 1-degree forecasts. The 0-moment evaporation is switched on and off by the host model (ClimaAtmos precipitation_evaporation_0m), so the coefficient no longer acts as the switch; description updated.
- Version 1.3.5.
